02 · Components

Capability specimens

The selected project profiles determine which comparable specimens appear. HTML is the review carrier; the target surface owns the rules.

Target profile

Capability profile summary

03 · States

Profile state obligations

State coverage is derived from the active profile instead of assuming browser hover, form controls, or responsive pixels apply everywhere.

04 · Motion

Purposeful movement

Motion reveals hierarchy, confirms an action, or explains a state change. Durations and easing are tokens; reduced motion is mandatory.

Entrance · reveal hierarchy

duration.slow easing.emphasized

Feedback · reinforce action

duration.base easing.emphasized

Transition · explain change

duration.slow easing.standard

05 · Responsive

Presentation targets

Targets retain their production unit—pixel, point, or terminal cell— while the HTML carrier uses a declared review width for comparison.
